title: Don't Practise Yoga Alone. Find Your Yoga Buddy.

continuity: A quiet coastal palm garden in Weligama, Sri Lanka, a level short-grass lawn beside a simple open-sided wooden yoga pavilion, with a glimpse of the calm Indian Ocean and palms behind. Soft warm early-morning light, airy natural shadows, authentic tropical garden, no dramatic cliffs or fantasy scenery. The two women are fictional adult travellers. Preserve their faces, hair, short sleeves, full-length leggings, mat colours and morning light. No brands on clothing or mats.

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: Hey! Love yoga but don't have anyone to practise with? You don't have to do it alone!

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: With Tips to Trip, use Meet Buddy to find travellers around you who share your interests.

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: Just open Meet Buddy, update your Travel Status, and tell other travellers what you're planning. Save it, and let them find you. It's that simple!

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: And look! Another traveller nearby is interested in joining.

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: Hey! You must be the one who replied to my post!

dialogues.speaker: mia
dialogues.text: So, don't miss out on amazing experiences just because you're travelling alone. Find your people with Tips to Trip Meet Buddy!

responseNote: Hey! I'm also in Weligama. I'd love to join you for yoga!
